name: Tilebrook: Slide & Match
subtitle: Calm ceramic tile matching
shortDescription: Match glazed tiles, then watch the brook carry the whole board. Every match changes what sits next to what. A new Daily Board arrives every day.
longDescription:
Tilebrook is a quiet tile-matching game with one twist you see in the first second: after every match, the brook flows and the whole board slides.

### How It Plays
Tap two tiles with the same glaze that can see each other along a row or a column, with only water between them. They leave the board. Then the current carries every remaining tile until it meets an edge, a mossy stone or another tile. A pair that was far apart can suddenly sit side by side. A pair that was side by side can drift apart. Each move is a small plan.

### Three Kinds of Brook
- Steady: the water always runs one way.
- Tide: the current turns after each match, and the small arrows show what is next.
- Steer: you choose where the tiles will slide, with a compass you can change at any time.

### Play Your Way
- 120 stages across ten bends of the brook, from a tiny first board to wide boards with stones. Boards are generated, and every one is checked to be solvable.
- Daily Board: one new board every day, the same for everyone, with a streak to keep.
- Endless: chain boards that keep growing, chain matches for combos and chase your best score.
- Rewind is free in stages. Optional video hints and a re-glaze (the same tiles dealt again) are there when you want them.

### A Shelf to Fill
Clearing boards fires pieces of pottery for your kiln shelf: 12 forms in three glazes, 36 pieces in all.

### Made to Be Calm
Glossy ceramic tiles on a celadon river scene, soft koto and water-drop sound, gentle haptics, and a calm-motion switch. Works offline. Plays in portrait and landscape on iPhone and iPad.
